main_results.result: Forward-only replay facade added over pinned historical attempt ledger. DETERMINISTIC_REPLAY now requires a trusted pre-score determinism contract; contract/registry digests are transitively bound into historical RESERVE request_binding_digest and attempt_id. FAIL_CLOSED request binding and retry policy are delegated unchanged.

Injected contract tests pass for fail-closed wire parity, pre-reserve rejection of uncontracted replay, exact authorization binding, fresh-epoch recovery, invalidation/revocation fail-closed behavior, historical replay non-reinterpretation, untrusted stochastic path rejection and exact execution-binding reconstruction.

A naive V4 integration was deliberately not persisted: current ADMIT contract, runtime auditor and CLOSE/replay hard-code the historical compliance runtime binding, so changing only RESERVE/recovery would make new slots fail runtime-provenance audit.

validated_contracts: Uncertified DETERMINISTIC_REPLAY is rejected before the historical attempt module prepares a reservation.

A trusted replay contract binds runtime fingerprint, scorer config digest, decoder config digest, protected statistic, attempt-id version, certificate identity/evidence digest/provenance digest, and invalidation conditions.

The authorization digest is inserted into a reserved request-binding namespace before the historical ledger computes request_binding_digest and attempt_id; fresh-epoch recovery must reproduce the exact same binding.
Certificate revocation, triggered invalidation conditions, or runtime/scorer/decoder/protected-statistic/attempt-id mismatch reject recovery before base replay.
Historical deterministic-replay reservations without the authorization envelope are not upgraded by the new facade.
The same authorization-bound request binding is required by downstream score launch and SLOT preparation; using the original unbound request later fails historical permit/request digest checks.
Production facade calls default to checking the injected attempt module against Git blob f51cc37e5897d8dc0f395da95c1f6dd1c12da791.

new_gap.name: forward_runtime_provenance_chain_not_yet_versioned_for_replay_authorization
new_gap.reason: Current top runtime binds ADMIT to historical base._binding(); current runtime-provenance auditor independently computes the same historical base._binding() as expected; current CLOSE/replay recognizes only current/historical auditor bindings. A replay-authorized RESERVE binding therefore cannot be introduced alone.
new_gap.safe_default: Keep active V3 and FAIL_CLOSED unchanged. Keep the new authorization facade non-default until ADMIT, RESERVE, auditor and CLOSE/replay are versioned together.

measurement_validity_rules: Same attempt_id is not a determinism certificate. Replay authorization must be fixed before scoring and must reference independent trusted certification evidence.
A trusted certificate registry is part of the scientific authority boundary; caller-created/self-asserted certificates are not accepted.
Protected equality level is explicit. A certificate for score equality must not be silently reused as token/raw-output equality, and vice versa.
The authorization-bound request binding is part of the attempt identity and must be reused across RESERVE, score launch and SLOT persistence.
Forward provenance versioning is scientific, not cosmetic: a pre-score ADMIT contract and the later RESERVE/auditor expected binding must agree exactly.
Historical reservations and historical ADMITs are never reinterpreted under a later replay-authorization policy.
scope_limitations: Facade contract tests used a faithful injected historical-ledger test double; exact full-sibling byte execution remains pending.
The facade enforces the presence/scope of a trusted certificate but does not itself establish runtime determinism.
No replay-authorized V4 runtime was persisted or activated after the provenance-chain mismatch was identified.
Single-host/process/runtime safety results from earlier checkpoints remain scoped as previously stated; no new multi-host guarantee is claimed.
frontier: Implement a forward-only runtime-provenance contract registry v2 that recognizes the frozen historical binding and a new replay-authorized binding by explicit binding_id/digest; do not accept arbitrary caller bindings.
Implement runtime-provenance auditor v2 that resolves expected reservation binding from the pre-score ADMIT contract version while preserving current V1 and historical behavior exactly.
Implement superseding CLOSE/replay that recognizes auditor/contract v2 and forbids downgrade for replay-authorized ADMITs.
Only after those pieces pass exact replay tests, persist a ProcessStableRuntime V4 that exposes deterministic replay only through the authorization facade and preserves default FAIL_CLOSED behavior.
Materialize the exact sibling graph for byte-execution and test deterministic versus stochastic repeated inference under a fixed runtime fingerprint at the protected score/sign level.

Define an allowlisted replay_authorized_v1 binding composed of the frozen compliance runtime binding plus facade blob f21613ebb6db487d70983ad46caf063ac86c804b, support the existing schema-v1 contract without reinterpretation, and unit-test binding resolution for historical/no-contract, current V1, recognized V2, digest mismatch, unknown binding_id and downgrade cases before changing any auditor or runtime.
